title: ExplorerLayout
responsibility: Frames explorer pages with shared navigation and renders the supplied child content in the main area.

inputs.name: ExplorerLayout.base
inputs.description: URL prefix used by the shared explorer header for links and navigation.

inputs.name: ExplorerLayout.problem
inputs.description: Load failure to display above the page, or an empty string when there is no failure.

inputs.name: ExplorerLayout.missing
inputs.type: { message: string; home: string | null } | null
inputs.description: Missing-history notice and optional return link; null keeps the notice hidden.

inputs.name: ExplorerLayout.navbar
inputs.description: Revision-scoped navigation, branch and commit choices, repository name and search entries.

inputs.name: ExplorerLayout.children
inputs.description: Required page content rendered in the main area below the shared navigation.

outputs.name: ExplorerLayout
outputs.description: Shared navigation around the supplied child content, retaining header notices and responsive spacing.
